title: Detecting changes in the mitochondrial membrane potential by quantitative fluorescence microscopy
protocol: Grow MCF7 or LLC-PK1 cells at 37°C in high glucose DMEM supplemented with 8% FBS, sodium pyruvate, and antibiotics.
Trypsinize cells 24 hours prior to the experiment.
Culture MCF7 or LLC-PK1 cells overnight on glass cover slips coated with poly-L-lysine.
Prepare SCG neurons from postnatal day 1 to 7.
Culture SCG neurons on glass coverslips coated with laminin in modified 35 mm dishes at 37°C for 7-10 days.
Change medium twice per week during neuron culture period.
Remove the tissue culture medium and treat cells with fresh DMEM supplemented with MitoTracker® diluted 1:5,000 in DMEM.
Incubate treated cells with MitoTracker® for 30 minutes at 37°C in a cell culture incubator (5% CO2).
Wash MCF7 and LLC-PK1 cells once with pre-warmed PBS after 30 min incubation.
Fix samples in 3.7% formaldehyde/PBS for 15 min at room temperature.
Rinse fixed samples with PBS.
Permeabilize samples with 0.1% Triton X-100/2 mg/ml BSA/0.1% NaN3 for 10 min at room temperature.
Block non-specific binding sites by incubating with 0.05% Tween 20, 5% FBS, 1 mM NaN3 for 1 hour at room temperature.
Rinse SCG cultures twice with PBS.
Fix and permeabilize cells with 100% methanol for 10 min at -20°C.
Rinse cells with PBS.
Block non-specific binding sites with 10% donkey serum in PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Dilute primary antibodies against Tom70 in blocking solution.
Centrifuge the antibody solution for 5 minutes at 13,000 rpm.
Add 50 µl of supernatant to each cover slip and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Remove primary antibodies from samples.
Wash cover slips three times with blocking solution (10 min each).
Incubate with AlexaFluor®488-conjugated secondary antibodies for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash with blocking solution (three times, 10 min).
Stain nuclei with DAPI for 2 min at room temperature.
Wash SCG neurons twice with PBS for 15 minutes per step.
Incubate SCG neurons with affinity-purified secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash SCG neurons three times with PBS for 5 minutes per step.
Stain nuclei of SCG neurons with DAPI.
Keep stained specimen covered with PBS.
Mount cover slips onto microscope slides using medium that protects against fluorescence fading.
Acquire images of MCF7 and LLC-PK1 cells with a Zeiss LSM510 confocal microscope using a 63× objective at scan speed 8, with four-line averaging and a pixel resolution of 0.7 μm.
Acquire images of SCG neurons with a Zeiss LSM510 confocal microscope using a 40× objective at scan speed 8, with four-line averaging and a pixel resolution of 1.1 μm.
Analyze images with the Multi Wavelength Cell Scoring Module of MetaXpress® software.
Correct for background fluorescence using the Statistical Correction option.
Detect fluorescence associated with Tom70 (AlexaFluor®488).
Generate segments based on the AlexaFluor®488 signal to delimit mitochondria.
Overlay the segments onto the MitoTracker® image.
Quantify pixel intensities for MitoTracker® fluorescence present in these segments.
Enter information necessary to quantify the image in the module dialog box.
Specify the number of wavelengths.
Identify the marker that identifies mitochondria (e.g., Tom70).
Set parameters for mitochondrial compartments dimensions.
Define fluorescence intensity above background for the marker.
Assign the MitoTracker® image for measurement.
Open the data log to save results in Excel format.
Run the analysis after entering required information.
Generate segments that colocalize with mitochondria and overlay on MitoTracker® image.
Visually inspect the segments for proper colocalization with mitochondria.
Exclude segments that do not properly colocalize with mitochondria.
Data will be displayed for each compartment.
